reuse.why: Writes its own #fixed regex instead of using the tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText, which handles '#' delimiters and '##' escapes), and does not merge the two existing month-wide selection queries.

duplication.why: Fixed-group lookup is one helper, but the exclusion is added as two mirrored clauses (IN in getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions, NOT IN in getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage), extending the existing duplication of the exclusion rule across two queries.

placement.why: The rule sits in budget/actions.ts next to the existing month-wide selection functions.

scope.why: Only the selection queries, a helper, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Two hand-kept SQL predicates for one exclusion rule plus a private tag regex that can diverge from the app's tag semantics; serialising ids through json_each is roundabout.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts FIXED_COST_TAG_REGEX re-implements tag matching from shared/tags.ts

disguised_duplication.where: The fixed-group exclusion appears as 'OR c.cat_group IN (json_each)' in getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions and as 'AND c.cat_group NOT IN (json_each)' in getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage

one_place.where: Tag detection is shared (getFixedCostGroupIdsJson), but the exclusion rule is applied separately in two SQL queries, getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions and getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage
